scripts.release: pnpm version $(Y=$(date +%Y); M=$(date +%-m); LAST=$(git tag --list "v${Y}.${M}.*" | awk -F. '{print $NF}' | sort -n | tail -1); echo ${Y}.${M}.$((${LAST:-0}+1)))
scripts.version: pnpm exec git-cliff --tag v$npm_package_version --unreleased --prepend CHANGELOG.md && git add CHANGELOG.md
